findings.title: Visitors looking for help may reach outdated contact details
findings.evidence: “contact support” is the 3rd most common site search (58 searches). The Contact and support page has a 31% engagement rate, the lowest of the 5 most visited pages, and was last updated 14 months ago.
findings.recommendation: Update the Contact and support page, and put the current way to get help in its first paragraph.

findings.title: Image help is hard to find from the pages that need it
findings.evidence: “image alt text” was searched 33 times. The Add a page guide (1,240 views) mentions images but doesn’t link to alt-text guidance.
findings.recommendation: Add a short alt-text section or link on Add a page, next to the image steps.

findings.title: The home page sends visitors onward without answering much itself
findings.evidence: The home page is the top landing page, with 48% engagement. Most engaged visits continue to Add a page or Update a menu.
findings.recommendation: Link the two most-used tasks from the top of the home page.
